project_info.theme: Toyota Vios gives peace of mind on every family journey
project_info.color_palette: Forest green, white, warm beige, black

main_subject.detail: A family-outdoor lifestyle poster with Toyota logo top left and a headline reading 'BEN TRONG VUNG AN TAM Moi hanh trinh DEU VUNG CHAI'. A white Toyota Vios sedan is parked on the roadside in a tree-filled park. On the left, a smiling father, mother, and young child play together on the grass beside the road. Bottom-right script says 'Move your world'.
main_subject.style: Warm family-oriented automotive poster with natural park scenery and a reassuring durability message

composition_elements.text: TOYOTA / BEN TRONG VUNG AN TAM / Moi hanh trinh / DEU VUNG CHAI / Move your world
items: Top Left: Toyota logo over a green park canopy
Top Right: Large mixed-style headline with handwritten 'Moi hanh trinh'
Bottom Left: Smiling family of three playing on the grass beside the curb
Bottom Right: White Toyota Vios on the road and handwritten 'Move your world'
Center/Background: Sunlit parkland and roadside scene with the Vios positioned as the calm family companion

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Leaf-filtered sunlight, gentle road reflections, warm family-outing mood

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for a Toyota Vios family-durability story. Centerpiece is a white Toyota Vios parked roadside beside a tree-filled park, while a mother, father, and child play together on the grass. Background is a bright green park under soft daylight. Surrounding elements: Toyota logo, exact headline 'BEN TRONG VUNG AN TAM Moi hanh trinh DEU VUNG CHAI', and footer script 'Move your world'. Technical style: photoreal family-lifestyle automotive composite, soft natural daylight, leaf-filtered sun and a warm family-outing mood, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
